# Cosmo SPA & Nails

> Nail salon & spa based in Round Rock, Texas. Family-owned by Ken and Angel since 2016. Long, relaxing pedicures with hot wax and massage chairs, gel, powder dip and acrylic sets, and hand-painted nail art on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock.

- Phone: (512) 255-2200
- Based in: Round Rock, TX
- Nearby areas: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Hutto, Georgetown, Cedar Park, Brushy Creek
- Google rating: 4.7 from 162 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/cosmo-spa-and-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/cosmo-spa-and-nails/book.html

## Services
- Pedicures: Long, relaxing pedicures in a massage chair, with no timer on the leg massage. The regular pedicure already includes the hot wax treatment.
- Manicures, gel & dip: Clean, polished hands and color that lasts: gel, powder dip and acrylic sets, plus honest advice on the shape and shade that suit you.
- Nail art: Bring an idea, even a tricky one, or let us get creative: hand-painted flowers, hearts, checks, seasonal sets and glitter accents.

## About
Ken and Angel opened Cosmo SPA & Nails in December 2016, in the Mays Crossing strip center on the I-35 frontage road in Round Rock. It's a bright, clean, family-owned salon: a white front desk, a wall of polish in every colour, and a row of massage pedicure chairs under the chandeliers. Regulars say the same things again and again: friendly, clean and fast, and the owners always remember you. The regular pedicure includes the hot wax treatment, there's no timer on the leg massage, and the techs will tell you honestly if a shape or shade would suit you better before doing exactly what you asked for. Fill up the rewards punch card and your next visit is discounted. Clients ask for Angel by name for creative, artistic nail art, and for Ken too. It gets busy, so call ahead or come back. In Ken and Angel's own words: “Come to enjoy with us, we will bring you happiness.”

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Does the regular pedicure include hot wax?
  A: Yes. Our regular pedicure includes the hot wax treatment on your feet, you'll be in a massage chair the whole time, and there's no timer on the leg massage.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome when a chair is open, but it gets busy. Call (512) 255-2200 to check or set up a time.
- Q: Do you do powder dip and acrylics?
  A: Yes. Gel manicures and pedicures, powder dip, acrylic full sets and fills, and polish changes.
- Q: Can you help me pick a shape or color?
  A: Yes. Tell us what you're thinking and we'll let you know what would suit your finger shape or skin tone. Then we'll do exactly what you want.
- Q: Do you do custom nail art?
  A: Yes. Hand-painted flowers, hearts, checks, seasonal sets and glitter accents. Ask for Angel if you want something creative.
- Q: Do you have a rewards card?
  A: Yes. We punch your card each visit, and once it's full you get a discount on your next visit.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Wednesday to Saturday 10 am to 6:30 pm, Sunday 11 am to 5 pm. Closed Tuesdays.
- Q: Where are you, and is there parking?
  A: 1201 S I-35 Frontage Rd #301, Round Rock, TX 78664, in the Mays Crossing strip center. There's a private parking lot and the salon is wheelchair accessible.
